items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: I started taking lessons very early, five, six years old, from a very good teacher from England, his name was Arthur Reginald Riley.

ctx.x: I did. I knew that. I wanted to be an artist, but I started taking lessons very early, five, six years old, from a very good teacher from England, his name was Arthur Reginald Riley. And he was a very good teacher. I learned to play classical music and read everything and plus I played in church you see. So it was a very — it didn’t seem unnatural for me. I knew that that was my life’s work at a very early age. It was either that or be a school teacher and I knew I didn’t want to be a school teacher.
I think we’re glad that you went the music route.
